rows.en: Ymir: "...How is Rayode? The person inside...?"
Celica: "Given the state it's in..."
Ymir: "I see..."
Celica: "But we're about to check that now.
After that, we'll recover Rayode...
Hey! Be more careful with it!"
Mechanic C: "Y-Yes!"
Touya: "...There's no surviving that, is there...?"
Celica: "I said we're about to... Hey, you're not supposed to get out!
I told you to stand by..."
Touya: "What's the harm? More importantly...?"
Yamato: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "I thought I saw something flash..."
Celica: "What...? Where?!"
Touya: "I think it was around the cockpit..."
Celica: "?! Everyone, get back! The hatch is opening!"
Mechanic F: "Look out!"
Mechanic C: "...Huh? Whoa!"
Yamato: "Oh! Someone's coming out!"
Lyle: "..."
Touya: "L-Lyle?!"
Celica: "Ymir! Run!"
Ymir: "What?!"
Yamato: "Oh! Is he going to take Ymir hostage?!"
Ymir: "Aaaaaah!"
Touya: "Ymir!"
Lyle: "Heh heh heh... You let your guard down...
Among all six machines, Rayode's protection
is the best..."
Touya: "Stop! Ymir is your..."
Lyle: "Don't move... If you move...?!"
Lyle: "...Th-This scent...
Where did you get this?"
Ymir: "Th-This is... a gift from Lady Ivel...
Perfume..."
Lyle: "Perfume? From that old hag...?"
Ivel: "My, my. I can't let 'old hag' pass without comment."
Celica: "Lady Ivel! Stay back!"
Ivel: "It's all right. Lyle... That perfume
is made from a formula Wenimas taught me twenty-nine years ago.
Fortunately, Lacrima still existed in this era..."
Lyle: "I see... So that's how it was...
Heh heh heh... What have I done...?"
Ymir: "..."
Lyle: "Wenimas... never betrayed me...
I was the one who betrayed her... I didn't trust her...
Touya: "That's what I was trying to tell you..."
Lyle: "Heh... Lacrima was the flower I gave her when I first
told her I loved her...
She said this to me then..."
Wenimas: "What a lovely scent..."
Lyle: "H-Hey... Well?
Give me a straight answer."
Wenimas: "My birthday is next month."
Lyle: "Y-Yeah... Hey, never mind that..."
Wenimas: "...Will you give me this again then?"
Lyle: "Every year after that, on her birthday,
I gave her Lacrima..."
Ivel: "In the language of flowers, Lacrima means 'radiance,'
and... 'eternal love.'
Ymir is Wenimas's child and yours."
Lyle: "My... daughter..."
Ymir: "..."
Sharl: "So you were here after all...
But how pathetic, getting yourself captured..."
Touya: "Tch! If she attacks now, we're in trouble..."
Lyle: "Heh... To think I'm her father, but I'm younger than my own daughter...
Ymir... You look so much like Wenimas...
I won't hurt anyone dear to me again..."
Ymir: "Oh..."
Celica: "Is he going to get into Rayode? But..."
Touya: "H-Hey! What the hell are you planning?!"
Celica: "No way! How can it move?!"
Sharl: "...What is the meaning of this?"
Lyle: "I'll give you Rayode's 'Core' and my life.
So please withdraw."
Sharl: "...You seem to be under a misapprehension.
Your life is worthless. Nothing but garbage.
There's no basis for a bargain."
Lyle: "Heh... I see... So that's no good...
Then how about your life?"
Sharl: "You intend to fight me in that condition?"
Celica: "Everyone, get clear!"
Sharl: "What a fool..."
Sharl: "What?! An illusion?!"
Lyle: "You're the fool..."
Lyle: "..."
Sharl: "Heh heh heh... Didn't I tell you?
You intend to fight me in that condition?
Well, then, I'll start with you..."
Lyle: "Heh... I knew that perfectly well...
I did it to get inside your guard..."
Sharl: "?!"
Lyle: "Raaaaaaaagh!!"
Sharl: "What are you doing...!! You don't mean...!"
Lyle: "I told you, didn't I? I'd give you my life..."
Sharl: "Impossible... Even if you do that,
Parthenos's armor..."
Lyle: "...I'm sure.
But it'll leave you no choice but to withdraw..."
Sharl: "You'd go that far...?"
Lyle: "Farewell, Ymir... My daughter..."
Ymir: "No... Don't!!"
Sharl: "Lyle... A fool to the very end..."
Touya: "Rishuna, Valga..."
Rishuna: "Hah, hah... I'm sorry... We're late..."
Valga: "It certainly takes a toll on an old body."
Sharl: "Shinkaio..."
Valga: "My power may be limited, but against you as you are now,
I can put up quite a fight."
Sharl: "I've recovered the 'Core'... As for Rayblade,
I'll leave that for another time...
I'll have to settle things with all of you eventually, too."
Rishuna: "I won't let you get aw..."
Rishuna: "Valga...?"
Valga: (Leave it. You can barely
keep yourself standing as it is, can't you?)
Rishuna: "..."
Sharl: "...Until we meet again..."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "...Why...? Why...? *sob*..."

review_batches.context: Examined0-83 and complete123-row member, plus earlier Lyle sacrifice variant. Rayode salvage, initially unknown occupant then Lyle emerges, hostage threat interrupted by perfume, Ivel29-year formula/Lacrima account, remembered Wenimas birthday and parentage revelation, Sharl arrival and withdrawal bargain.
review_batches.decisions: No death proved before Lyle emerges, no resurrection. Rayode protection among six is claim. Ivel/Wenimas29-year perfume account, not recipe; Lacrima flower symbolism fictional and spelling editorial. Actual memory scene not living Wenimas return. Parent younger-than-daughter paradox preserved without new mechanics. Rayode Core not Rayblade Core, threats/garbage insult full force with no additional harm detail.
